meta.title: Polarday
meta.description: In the darkest hour, hope springs eternal.

units.rawText: Urgh... unf!
units.displayText: Urgh... unf!

spans.text: Urgh... unf!

units.rawText: Another jolt of pain shoots through Persicaria's body as the glaive once again stabs through her arm.
units.displayText: Another jolt of pain shoots through Persicaria's body as the glaive once again stabs through her arm.

spans.text: Another jolt of pain shoots through Persicaria's body as the glaive once again stabs through her arm.

units.rawText: She groans, then counters with a chop. Sol can't dodge in time and takes the blow directly. What surprises her is that she doesn't feel the seething pain of the blow; the only thing in her eyes is her burning thirst for victory.
units.displayText: She groans, then counters with a chop. Sol can't dodge in time and takes the blow directly. What surprises her is that she doesn't feel the seething pain of the blow; the only thing in her eyes is her burning thirst for victory.

spans.text: She groans, then counters with a chop. Sol can't dodge in time and takes the blow directly. What surprises her is that she doesn't feel the seething pain of the blow; the only thing in her eyes is her burning thirst for victory.

units.rawText: ...You're slowing down... Are you out of operands?
units.displayText: ...You're slowing down... Are you out of operands?

spans.text: ...You're slowing down... Are you out of operands?

units.rawText: (Pants) To think you'd actually cut away a part of yourself to abandon your memories, and in exchange, you gained a temporary surge of strength.
units.displayText: (Pants) To think you'd actually cut away a part of yourself to abandon your memories, and in exchange, you gained a temporary surge of strength.

spans.text: (Pants) To think you'd actually cut away a part of yourself to abandon your memories, and in exchange, you gained a temporary surge of strength.

units.rawText: But that means your operand consumption rate is going to spike... until you run dry.
units.displayText: But that means your operand consumption rate is going to spike... until you run dry.

spans.text: But that means your operand consumption rate is going to spike... until you run dry.

units.rawText: Soon... you're going to burn yourself out.
units.displayText: Soon... you're going to burn yourself out.

spans.text: Soon... you're going to burn yourself out.

units.rawText: That's fine too. I'll kill both of you before I do.
units.displayText: That's fine too. I'll kill both of you before I do.

spans.text: That's fine too. I'll kill both of you before I do.

units.rawText: Yeeart—
units.displayText: Yeeart—

spans.text: Yeeart—

units.rawText: Another arc of flame sweeps in at her chest. Persicaria takes a step back and barely manages to get her sword in the way, blocking her opponent's stroke.
units.displayText: Another arc of flame sweeps in at her chest. Persicaria takes a step back and barely manages to get her sword in the way, blocking her opponent's stroke.

spans.text: Another arc of flame sweeps in at her chest. Persicaria takes a step back and barely manages to get her sword in the way, blocking her opponent's stroke.

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: Hng...
units.displayText: Hng...

spans.text: Hng...

units.rawText: The deadly edge is getting closer and closer to her chest, but her sword arm feels as heavy as a sinking ship.
units.displayText: The deadly edge is getting closer and closer to her chest, but her sword arm feels as heavy as a sinking ship.

spans.text: The deadly edge is getting closer and closer to her chest, but her sword arm feels as heavy as a sinking ship.

units.rawText: Heh...
units.displayText: Heh...

spans.text: Heh...

units.rawText: Why are you laughing... What are you looking at?!
units.displayText: Why are you laughing... What are you looking at?!

spans.text: Why are you laughing... What are you looking at?!

units.rawText: I'm looking at the thing you threw away!
units.displayText: I'm looking at the thing you threw away!

spans.text: I'm looking at the thing you threw away!

units.rawText: Persicaria ducks to the right and lets the sharp blade graze past her, leaving a shallow wound on her chest. The fabric there is shredded, exposing everything beneath and her necklace to the open air.
units.displayText: Persicaria ducks to the right and lets the sharp blade graze past her, leaving a shallow wound on her chest. The fabric there is shredded, exposing everything beneath and her necklace to the open air.

spans.text: Persicaria ducks to the right and lets the sharp blade graze past her, leaving a shallow wound on her chest. The fabric there is shredded, exposing everything beneath and her necklace to the open air.

units.rawText: The girl in black finds her gaze drawn to the little green leaf in the bottle. It seems to be glowing with a strange radiance in the reflected firelight.
units.displayText: The girl in black finds her gaze drawn to the little green leaf in the bottle. It seems to be glowing with a strange radiance in the reflected firelight.

spans.text: The girl in black finds her gaze drawn to the little green leaf in the bottle. It seems to be glowing with a strange radiance in the reflected firelight.

units.rawText: (This feeling again... It's warm, yet painful...)
units.displayText: This feeling again... It's warm, yet painful...

spans.text: This feeling again... It's warm, yet painful...

units.rawText: (Damn it, why am I so fascinated with that damn necklace... It's like I'm possessed or something!)
units.displayText: Damn it, why am I so fascinated with that damn necklace... It's like I'm possessed or something!

spans.text: Damn it, why am I so fascinated with that damn necklace... It's like I'm possessed or something!

units.rawText: Clatter—
units.displayText: Clatter—

spans.text: Clatter—

units.rawText: Persicaria seizes on Sol's moment of distraction and grabs a chain from the ground, then whirls and quickly tosses it at her opponent.
units.displayText: Persicaria seizes on Sol's moment of distraction and grabs a chain from the ground, then whirls and quickly tosses it at her opponent.

spans.text: Persicaria seizes on Sol's moment of distraction and grabs a chain from the ground, then whirls and quickly tosses it at her opponent.

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: The chain snares Sol's glaive.
units.displayText: The chain snares Sol's glaive.

spans.text: The chain snares Sol's glaive.

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl pulls it taut, then closes in at top speed, throwing herself at Sol with all her might as she reverses her sword and hammers Sol hard with the back of the blade.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl pulls it taut, then closes in at top speed, throwing herself at Sol with all her might as she reverses her sword and hammers Sol hard with the back of the blade.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl pulls it taut, then closes in at top speed, throwing herself at Sol with all her might as she reverses her sword and hammers Sol hard with the back of the blade.

units.rawText: Gwaaargh!
units.displayText: Gwaaargh!

spans.text: Gwaaargh!

units.rawText: Sol stumbles backward from the impact and falls to the ground in a daze.
units.displayText: Sol stumbles backward from the impact and falls to the ground in a daze.

spans.text: Sol stumbles backward from the impact and falls to the ground in a daze.

units.rawText: Thud!
units.displayText: Thud!

spans.text: Thud!

units.rawText: Urgh... This is... the stake and chain from my chest...
units.displayText: Urgh... This is... the stake and chain from my chest...

spans.text: Urgh... This is... the stake and chain from my chest...

units.rawText: ...Even though I cast them aside... they're still... binding me...
units.displayText: ...Even though I cast them aside... they're still... binding me...

spans.text: ...Even though I cast them aside... they're still... binding me...

units.rawText: You shouldn't have abandoned them.
units.displayText: You shouldn't have abandoned them.

spans.text: You shouldn't have abandoned them.

units.rawText: The chain is now wrapped tightly around her glaive and arms. Her formerly raging flames have almost gone out. The operands oozing from her chest are like sparks from a fire and soon dissipate into the air.
units.displayText: The chain is now wrapped tightly around her glaive and arms. Her formerly raging flames have almost gone out. The operands oozing from her chest are like sparks from a fire and soon dissipate into the air.

spans.text: The chain is now wrapped tightly around her glaive and arms. Her formerly raging flames have almost gone out. The operands oozing from her chest are like sparks from a fire and soon dissipate into the air.

units.rawText: The echoes of the fight are still reverberating through the air, but as the operands fade, she feels the fatigue close in on her.
units.displayText: The echoes of the fight are still reverberating through the air, but as the operands fade, she feels the fatigue close in on her.

spans.text: The echoes of the fight are still reverberating through the air, but as the operands fade, she feels the fatigue close in on her.

units.rawText: Persicaria presses her sword to Sol's core. After seeing this, her crimson eyes gradually go dull.
units.displayText: Persicaria presses her sword to Sol's core. After seeing this, her crimson eyes gradually go dull.

spans.text: Persicaria presses her sword to Sol's core. After seeing this, her crimson eyes gradually go dull.

units.rawText: You've lost...
units.displayText: You've lost...

spans.text: You've lost...

units.rawText: Yes. How will you deal with me?
units.displayText: Yes. How will you deal with me?

spans.text: Yes. How will you deal with me?

units.rawText: The two of them stare at each other in silence. Persicaria closes her eyes. Her neural cloud is filled with sweet memories of a past that is now forever beyond reach.
units.displayText: The two of them stare at each other in silence. Persicaria closes her eyes. Her neural cloud is filled with sweet memories of a past that is now forever beyond reach.

spans.text: The two of them stare at each other in silence. Persicaria closes her eyes. Her neural cloud is filled with sweet memories of a past that is now forever beyond reach.

units.rawText: When she opens her eyes again, Persicaria looks at the girl in black and speaks slowly.
units.displayText: When she opens her eyes again, Persicaria looks at the girl in black and speaks slowly.

spans.text: When she opens her eyes again, Persicaria looks at the girl in black and speaks slowly.

units.rawText: I'll bring the fallen sun home with my own two hands.
units.displayText: I'll bring the fallen sun home with my own two hands.

spans.text: I'll bring the fallen sun home with my own two hands.

units.rawText: I'll take her back with this sword that she left me!
units.displayText: I'll take her back with this sword that she left me!

spans.text: I'll take her back with this sword that she left me!

units.rawText: The pink-haired girl turns to Sol's chest and raises Arvak high.
units.displayText: The pink-haired girl turns to Sol's chest and raises Arvak high.

spans.text: The pink-haired girl turns to Sol's chest and raises Arvak high.

units.rawText: Your neural cloud belonged to Sol. It's time I returned it to its owner!
units.displayText: Your neural cloud belonged to Sol. It's time I returned it to its owner!

spans.text: Your neural cloud belonged to Sol. It's time I returned it to its owner!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>GWAAAAAAARRRGH—</size></color>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAARRRGH—

spans.text: GWAAAAAAARRRGH—

units.rawText: The core's trembling passes through the sword and into Persicaria's hands, as though her old friend were begging her for help from a darkened abyss.
units.displayText: The core's trembling passes through the sword and into Persicaria's hands, as though her old friend were begging her for help from a darkened abyss.

spans.text: The core's trembling passes through the sword and into Persicaria's hands, as though her old friend were begging her for help from a darkened abyss.

units.rawText: Sol... Sol!
units.displayText: Sol... Sol!

spans.text: Sol... Sol!

units.rawText: It hurts, right? It'll be okay, just bear with it... It'll be better soon...
units.displayText: It hurts, right? It'll be okay, just bear with it... It'll be better soon...

spans.text: It hurts, right? It'll be okay, just bear with it... It'll be better soon...

units.rawText: The skin around her wound tears open, revealing intricate machinery.
units.displayText: The skin around her wound tears open, revealing intricate machinery.

spans.text: The skin around her wound tears open, revealing intricate machinery.

units.rawText: Persicaria bends down and tries to touch Sol's core, but the girl in black below her thrashes around violently.
units.displayText: Persicaria bends down and tries to touch Sol's core, but the girl in black below her thrashes around violently.

spans.text: Persicaria bends down and tries to touch Sol's core, but the girl in black below her thrashes around violently.

units.rawText: <size=40>Let go of me!!</size>
units.displayText: Let go of me!!

spans.text: Let go of me!!

units.rawText: <size=40>If you're going to do this, then you might as well destroy it! Kill me!</size>
units.displayText: If you're going to do this, then you might as well destroy it! Kill me!

spans.text: If you're going to do this, then you might as well destroy it! Kill me!

units.rawText: I just want to restore you to how you used to be!
units.displayText: I just want to restore you to how you used to be!

spans.text: I just want to restore you to how you used to be!

units.rawText: Those words seem to strike a nerve, and the black-clad girl's eyes suddenly narrow as she screams in a pained voice.
units.displayText: Those words seem to strike a nerve, and the black-clad girl's eyes suddenly narrow as she screams in a pained voice.

spans.text: Those words seem to strike a nerve, and the black-clad girl's eyes suddenly narrow as she screams in a pained voice.

units.rawText: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!
units.displayText: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!

spans.text: I'm an Entropic... I'm not the Sol you're talking about!

units.rawText: <color=red>And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!</color>
units.displayText: And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!

spans.text: And as an Entropic... I belong in Tartarus!!

units.rawText: The girl in black explodes with power and kicks Sol heavily in the gut.
units.displayText: The girl in black explodes with power and kicks Sol heavily in the gut.

spans.text: The girl in black explodes with power and kicks Sol heavily in the gut.

units.rawText: Oof... S-Sol...
units.displayText: Oof... S-Sol...

spans.text: Oof... S-Sol...

units.rawText: Agonizing pain spreads, but Persicaria refuses to release the chain in her hands. Nevertheless, the chain inevitably slips with her movements.
units.displayText: Agonizing pain spreads, but Persicaria refuses to release the chain in her hands. Nevertheless, the chain inevitably slips with her movements.

spans.text: Agonizing pain spreads, but Persicaria refuses to release the chain in her hands. Nevertheless, the chain inevitably slips with her movements.

units.rawText: The girl in black seizes this opportunity to steady her trembling body by sheer force of will, reigniting her flames from her core outwards.
units.displayText: The girl in black seizes this opportunity to steady her trembling body by sheer force of will, reigniting her flames from her core outwards.

spans.text: The girl in black seizes this opportunity to steady her trembling body by sheer force of will, reigniting her flames from her core outwards.

units.rawText: ...I won't fade away...
units.displayText: ...I won't fade away...

spans.text: ...I won't fade away...

units.rawText: <size=40>...And I won't... let you... pass!</size>
units.displayText: ...And I won't... let you... pass!

spans.text: ...And I won't... let you... pass!

units.rawText: As the fire scorches it, her core stops trembling. The girl in black collapses, leaving a trail in the air like a meteor.
units.displayText: As the fire scorches it, her core stops trembling. The girl in black collapses, leaving a trail in the air like a meteor.

spans.text: As the fire scorches it, her core stops trembling. The girl in black collapses, leaving a trail in the air like a meteor.

units.rawText: Thunk!
units.displayText: Thunk!

spans.text: Thunk!

units.rawText: There is a dull thud as her body hits the floor, and the fires wreathing her gradually go out...
units.displayText: There is a dull thud as her body hits the floor, and the fires wreathing her gradually go out...

spans.text: There is a dull thud as her body hits the floor, and the fires wreathing her gradually go out...

units.rawText: The world suddenly goes silent.
units.displayText: The world suddenly goes silent.

spans.text: The world suddenly goes silent.

units.rawText: The canary with broken wings lies still and lifeless on the ground.
units.displayText: The canary with broken wings lies still and lifeless on the ground.

spans.text: The canary with broken wings lies still and lifeless on the ground.

units.rawText: Why...
units.displayText: Why...

spans.text: Why...

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at her friend who lays fallen once again. This similar situation overlaps with her memories, and helplessness wells up in her heart like a rising tide.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at her friend who lays fallen once again. This similar situation overlaps with her memories, and helplessness wells up in her heart like a rising tide.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at her friend who lays fallen once again. This similar situation overlaps with her memories, and helplessness wells up in her heart like a rising tide.

units.rawText: Why did things end up like this... Sol...
units.displayText: Why did things end up like this... Sol...

spans.text: Why did things end up like this... Sol...

units.rawText: All I wanted... was to bring you back... We all missed you...
units.displayText: All I wanted... was to bring you back... We all missed you...

spans.text: All I wanted... was to bring you back... We all missed you...

units.rawText: I... missed you too...
units.displayText: I... missed you too...

spans.text: I... missed you too...

units.rawText: Had she been wrong all this time? Whose fault was it?
units.displayText: Had she been wrong all this time? Whose fault was it?

spans.text: Had she been wrong all this time? Whose fault was it?

units.rawText: The sun has fallen, leaving behind those who could not bear the dark.
units.displayText: The sun has fallen, leaving behind those who could not bear the dark.

spans.text: The sun has fallen, leaving behind those who could not bear the dark.

units.rawText: Was it the fault of the fallen sun? She once burned herself to warm the world. Even if she could no longer shine, how could the people who had felt her warmth bear to censure her...
units.displayText: Was it the fault of the fallen sun? She once burned herself to warm the world. Even if she could no longer shine, how could the people who had felt her warmth bear to censure her...

spans.text: Was it the fault of the fallen sun? She once burned herself to warm the world. Even if she could no longer shine, how could the people who had felt her warmth bear to censure her...

units.rawText: Then, was it the fault of the people stranded in the darkness who sought warmth? Fearful of the dark, they longed to bathe in the sunlight once again, but that too was natural and beyond reproach.
units.displayText: Then, was it the fault of the people stranded in the darkness who sought warmth? Fearful of the dark, they longed to bathe in the sunlight once again, but that too was natural and beyond reproach.

spans.text: Then, was it the fault of the people stranded in the darkness who sought warmth? Fearful of the dark, they longed to bathe in the sunlight once again, but that too was natural and beyond reproach.

units.rawText: Sol...
units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.rawText: Persicaria stares dumbly at the chain she's holding. The liquid Entropy still remaining on the stake drips to the ground. The black-clad girl ripped it out of her chest despite the pain of doing so in order to escape the bonds of her memories.
units.displayText: Persicaria stares dumbly at the chain she's holding. The liquid Entropy still remaining on the stake drips to the ground. The black-clad girl ripped it out of her chest despite the pain of doing so in order to escape the bonds of her memories.

spans.text: Persicaria stares dumbly at the chain she's holding. The liquid Entropy still remaining on the stake drips to the ground. The black-clad girl ripped it out of her chest despite the pain of doing so in order to escape the bonds of her memories.

units.rawText: Everything seems to be telling her that she's been blinded by her selfish desires and that she's shackled her old friend once again, cutting off the new path she's found for herself...
units.displayText: Everything seems to be telling her that she's been blinded by her selfish desires and that she's shackled her old friend once again, cutting off the new path she's found for herself...

spans.text: Everything seems to be telling her that she's been blinded by her selfish desires and that she's shackled her old friend once again, cutting off the new path she's found for herself...

units.rawText: Was I the chain that was binding you, Sol?
units.displayText: Was I the chain that was binding you, Sol?

spans.text: Was I the chain that was binding you, Sol?

units.rawText: However, before Persicaria can arrive at an answer, a strange change takes place in the girl's body.
units.displayText: However, before Persicaria can arrive at an answer, a strange change takes place in the girl's body.

spans.text: However, before Persicaria can arrive at an answer, a strange change takes place in the girl's body.

units.rawText: Are... her wounds healing?
units.displayText: Are... her wounds healing?

spans.text: Are... her wounds healing?

units.rawText: The gory wound where her core is located is closing up at a speed visible to the naked eye. The signal fluctuations representing her life are gradually recovering, as though their gruesome duel just now was nothing more than a blood-soaked nightmare.
units.displayText: The gory wound where her core is located is closing up at a speed visible to the naked eye. The signal fluctuations representing her life are gradually recovering, as though their gruesome duel just now was nothing more than a blood-soaked nightmare.

spans.text: The gory wound where her core is located is closing up at a speed visible to the naked eye. The signal fluctuations representing her life are gradually recovering, as though their gruesome duel just now was nothing more than a blood-soaked nightmare.

units.rawText: She died. And now she has come back to life.
units.displayText: She died. And now she has come back to life.

spans.text: She died. And now she has come back to life.

units.rawText: Persicaria once heard of such a situation before... The Professor told her about it.
units.displayText: Persicaria once heard of such a situation before... The Professor told her about it.

spans.text: Persicaria once heard of such a situation before... The Professor told her about it.

units.rawText: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of its own.
units.displayText: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of its own.

spans.text: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of its own.

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus, your wound?
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus, your wound?

spans.text: ...Eosphorus, your wound?

units.rawText: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!
units.displayText: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!

spans.text: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!

units.rawText: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.
units.displayText: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.

spans.text: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.

units.rawText: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.
units.displayText: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.

spans.text: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.

units.rawText: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!
units.displayText: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!

spans.text: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!

units.rawText: <size=40>SHUT UP!</size>
units.displayText: SHUT UP!

spans.text: SHUT UP!

units.rawText: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.
units.displayText: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.

spans.text: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.

units.rawText: Is this why... Malkira came back to life?

units.rawText: Could it be...
units.displayText: Could it be...

spans.text: Could it be...

units.rawText: <size=40>...No, no, no, I need to subdue her now—</size>
units.displayText: ...No, no, no, I need to subdue her now—

spans.text: ...No, no, no, I need to subdue her now—

units.rawText: Crash!
units.displayText: Crash!

spans.text: Crash!

units.rawText: Before Persicaria can make a move, a thick tentacle suddenly slugs her hard, in the gut. Her wound opens up again and Persicaria almost passes out from the pain.
units.displayText: Before Persicaria can make a move, a thick tentacle suddenly slugs her hard, in the gut. Her wound opens up again and Persicaria almost passes out from the pain.

spans.text: Before Persicaria can make a move, a thick tentacle suddenly slugs her hard, in the gut. Her wound opens up again and Persicaria almost passes out from the pain.

units.rawText: Sol, who was once covered in wounds, is now as good as new. She stands tall in Persicaria's vision like an unconquerable mountain.
units.displayText: Sol, who was once covered in wounds, is now as good as new. She stands tall in Persicaria's vision like an unconquerable mountain.

spans.text: Sol, who was once covered in wounds, is now as good as new. She stands tall in Persicaria's vision like an unconquerable mountain.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: While I don't know why I woke up... I won't mess up again this time.
units.displayText: While I don't know why I woke up... I won't mess up again this time.

spans.text: While I don't know why I woke up... I won't mess up again this time.

units.rawText: (Coughs) I finally know... where your obsession... comes from...
units.displayText: (Coughs) I finally know... where your obsession... comes from...

spans.text: (Coughs) I finally know... where your obsession... comes from...

units.rawText: The girl in black frowns, waiting for the person before her to answer the question in her heart.
units.displayText: The girl in black frowns, waiting for the person before her to answer the question in her heart.

spans.text: The girl in black frowns, waiting for the person before her to answer the question in her heart.

units.rawText: ...This form of yours and your obsession with the Entropics...
units.displayText: ...This form of yours and your obsession with the Entropics...

spans.text: ...This form of yours and your obsession with the Entropics...

units.rawText: You said that you've never left the Sector... but that's because you can't leave it.
units.displayText: You said that you've never left the Sector... but that's because you can't leave it.

spans.text: You said that you've never left the Sector... but that's because you
can't
leave it.

units.rawText: You said you would fight for the Entropics... but that's not what you truly want, deep down.
units.displayText: You said you would fight for the Entropics... but that's not what you truly want, deep down.

spans.text: You said you would fight for the Entropics... but that's not what you truly want, deep down.

units.rawText: That's because... part of your neural cloud comes from Sol, and the other part...
units.displayText: That's because... part of your neural cloud comes from Sol, and the other part...

spans.text: That's because... part of your neural cloud comes from Sol, and the other part...

units.rawText: ...Comes from the Entropic mastermind, Malkira.
units.displayText: ...Comes from the Entropic mastermind, Malkira.

spans.text: ...Comes from the Entropic mastermind, Malkira.

units.rawText: Persicaria looks up at the revived girl in black from where she's sprawled on the ground, her eyes filled with sorrow.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks up at the revived girl in black from where she's sprawled on the ground, her eyes filled with sorrow.

spans.text: Persicaria looks up at the revived girl in black from where she's sprawled on the ground, her eyes filled with sorrow.

units.rawText: You have inherited Malkira's curse of deathlessness...
units.displayText: You have inherited Malkira's curse of deathlessness...

spans.text: You have inherited Malkira's curse of deathlessness...

units.rawText: <color=red>...Which means I can no longer bring you back to the Oasis, Sol.</color>
units.displayText: ...Which means I can no longer bring you back to the Oasis, Sol.

spans.text: ...Which means I can no longer bring you back to the Oasis, Sol.

units.rawText: Splurch!
units.displayText: Splurch!

spans.text: Splurch!
